## Outcome

What is true when this is done, in a sentence or two. What a user sees, if anything.

## Design

The design page and section this comes from, e.g. `docs/design/<page>.md`, "<Section>". Read that section; the rest only if needed.

## Agreed numbers and constraints

Numbers Jason has agreed, with the date. Constraints: saves, performance, things not to touch. Anything not agreed here is a question for Jason, not a guess.

## Done when

- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (or the fingerprint shows no change, for a refactor)
- [ ] The docs it touches are updated; a changelog line if a user would notice
- [ ] The project's check and test commands pass
- [ ] Jason has the commit message

## Out of scope

What this issue does not do, and where that work lives (another issue, or later).
